name: workflow
description: Skills and hooks for the development flow from request to merge (including how PR reviews are routed and awaited), issue operations, session handoffs and runbook recording, plus a mod that writes usage limits to a file

review_heavy.title: Review tools for heavy PRs
review_heavy.description: Review tools for heavy PRs when the repo's CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md has no review-heavy: line (comma-separated, e.g. coderabbit,codex; none means no tool). Available ids: codex, coderabbit, copilot, gemini, cursor-bugbot. If empty, pr-review-triage asks the user

review_light.title: Review for light PRs
review_light.description: What reviews light PRs when the repo's CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md has no review-light: line. claude means Claude reviews. Tool ids (e.g. coderabbit,codex) treat light PRs like heavy ones (no review:light label). A list such as claude,codex means Claude reviews and the listed tools' results are awaited too

review_auto.title: Automatic tool reviews (on / off)
review_auto.description: Value used when the repo's CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md has no review-auto: line. on keeps the tools' automatic reviews on and creates only light PRs with the review:light label to exclude them. off assumes automatic reviews are turned off and requests a review per PR

rereview_threshold.title: Serious findings that trigger a re-review
rereview_threshold.description: Ask the tools used in that round for a re-review only when at least this many serious findings (CodeRabbit Critical / Codex P1 / Critical or High for others) were fixed
